body.statement: Let every training-fold operator use \(\widehat N=I_{K^{2}}-\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B(\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B)^{+}\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\). If each fold satisfies \(R_{\Sigma}=o_P(1)\) and \(\Delta_n=o_P(n^{-1/2})\), then \(\sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)+o_P(1)\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)\rightsquigarrow N(0,V_{\mathrm{eff}})\), and \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}\to_PV_{\mathrm{eff}}\).
body.justification: The result pairs the efficiency bound with an attaining estimator and exposes every required nuisance product.
body.gap: Bian, Zhou, and Cui prove asymptotic normality for their hidden-action estimator, and Zhou and Tchetgen Tchetgen treat binary hidden treatment; neither theorem covers the exact projected multilevel score and its coherent-fit remainder.
body.consumer: It yields efficient standard errors for each latent maternal-smoking exposure mean.
body.proof_tex:
Let \(S(O)=U(O)-QU(O)=\psi+\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O)\), and on fold \(f\) let \(\widehat S_f=\widehat U_f-\widehat Q_f\widehat U_f\).  Add and subtract foldwise conditional means to obtain
\[
\begin{aligned}
\sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)
={}&n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)\\
&+n^{-1/2}\sum_{f=1}^{F_{\mathrm{fold}}}\sum_{i:\,\mathrm{fold}(i)=f}
\bigl[(\widehat S_f-S)(O_i)-P(\widehat S_f-S)\bigr]\\
&+n^{-1/2}\sum_{f=1}^{F_{\mathrm{fold}}}n_fP(\widehat S_f-\psi). 
\end{aligned} \tag{43}
\]
Conditional on each training sample, the middle line has variance at most a fixed-fold constant times \(\|\widehat S_f-S\|_2^2\).  Lemma 6 and \(R_\Sigma=o_P(1)\), followed by conditional Chebyshev, make it \(o_P(1)\).  Lemma 7 bounds the norm of the last line by \(\sqrt n\,C_{\mathrm{reg}}\Delta_n=o_P(1)\).  This proves the asymptotic linear expansion.

The influence function is bounded on the regular stratum.  For any fixed \(t\in\mathbb R^K\), a second-order Taylor expansion of its characteristic function gives
\[
E\exp\{it^{\mathsf T}\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}/\sqrt n\}
=1-\frac{t^{\mathsf T}V_{\mathrm{eff}}t}{2n}+o(n^{-1}),
\]
uniformly for fixed \(t\).  Independence raises this expression to the \(n\)-th power, whose limit is \(\exp\{-t^{\mathsf T}V_{\mathrm{eff}}t/2\}\).  Thus the leading vector in (43) converges to \(N(0,V_{\mathrm{eff}})\), and the same holds for the estimator.

Finally, Lemma 6 gives foldwise \(L^2\) convergence of the estimated scores to \(S\).  Conditional laws of large numbers on the held-out folds, finite-fold summation, and \(\widehat\psi\to_P\psi\) show that their centered empirical second moment converges to \(E\{(S-\psi)(S-\psi)^{\mathsf T}\}=V_{\mathrm{eff}}\).  Hence \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}\to_PV_{\mathrm{eff}}\).
